sources_used.source: Cylex business directory - Monroe Township category pages and keyword searches (plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, construction, cleaning, landscaping, auto, appliance, locksmith, solar, oil, glass)
Google Maps local search in a real browser (roofing, general contractor, electrician, landscaping, tree service, towing, cleaning service, auto body)
CityVero Monroe Township business directory - auto repair, landscaping, lawn care, plumbing category pages
BestProsInTown Monroe NJ business profiles (pest control)
NJ Business Directory - Monroe Township listings
Yellow Pages listings surfaced in search results (site blocks automated access)
BBB profile pages (fence contractor; landscaping) surfaced by search
OpenStreetMap Nominatim geocoder - used to recompute straight-line distances from Milltown centre to Monroe addresses
Industry buyers' guide / trade directory pages surfaced in search

categories_thin: Towing: only Bobby's Towing and All Around Towing were confirmed with in-township addresses; Sullivan's Flatbed (952 Route 33) and the Route 33 East shops fall outside the 10-mile band

Tree care: only RKD Tree Services and Love's Tree Removal appear as dedicated tree services in Google Maps' Monroe results; most Monroe 'tree service' hits are landscapers that also do tree work, and several arborists serving Monroe are based in East Brunswick or Jamesburg
Insulation, waterproofing and chimney specialists: almost none publish a Monroe Township address; directory entries are based in neighbouring towns and only advertise Monroe as a service area

Garage doors and locksmiths: the categories are polluted by apparent lead-generation listings sharing single phone numbers, so the entries that looked like a call-centre network were held out of the list (see caveats)
Moving and storage: four in-township movers found; self-storage is essentially national brands (Penske, U-Haul) which are excluded as chains

Roofing, electrical and auto repair were re-searched with map and web queries in this revision and produced new businesses (Scotchwood, Anna Electric, GD Auto Repair, B&W Auto Repair, A&J Motors), so those gaps are partly closed
caveats: Distance filter (recomputed in this revision): straight-line miles from Milltown centre 40.4498,-74.4407 were recalculated with OpenStreetMap coordinates for the addresses in question. Confirmed in-zone: SMC Fence 121 Old Forge Rd about 6.7 mi (the earlier 10.8 mi note was wrong and has been corrected), Bobby's Towing 31 Bordentown Tpke about 5.8 mi, RKD Tree 433 Schoolhouse Rd about 8.2 mi, Scotchwood 1 Compton Ct about 8.8 mi, GD Auto Repair 1600 Perrineville Rd about 9.2 mi.

Excluded on the distance rule even though they are genuine Monroe Township businesses (owner may want a separate pass): Jerry Noonan's Auto Center 251 Applegarth Rd about 10.3 mi; CBA Autoworks 31 Gravel Hill-Spotswood Rd about 10.3 mi; Garden State Landscaping & Tree Service 145 Union Valley Rd about 10.2 mi; Garden State Roofing 17 Greylynne Dr about 11.1 mi; Comfort Oil 228 Dey Grove Rd about 11.5 mi; Intelliscape Landscaping 314 Dey Grove Rd about 11.5 mi; Edison Electric 181 Dey Grove Rd about 11.8 mi; Family Overhead Doors 207 Dey Grove Rd about 11.8 mi. Distances are OSM-coordinate estimates, not surveyed, so the two around 10.2-10.3 mi are borderline.

Removed from the list in this revision for source or location problems: JANCO Electric (Manalapan Township business, outside the zone); Diamond Electrical Services (no Monroe address found - its site targets North/East Brunswick); Martin & Sons Roofing (service-area landing page with an out-of-area 551 phone, no verified Monroe address or registration); Hunt Construction Group (the 1095 Cranbury-South River Rd office was a former New Jersey office of a large national construction manager).

Held out of the prospect list as suspected one-operator/lead-generation clusters: AABC Locks, JMC Lock & Security, K Locksmith (all 609-619-02xx/03xx), Apex Appliance Repair (shared (732) 257-4590 with 'American Chimney Cleaning') and Muffler Auto Center (same address and phone as 'Royal Transmissions Inc'). Each needs a distinct trade-name or registration match before outreach. Other listings that merely share the 609-619 exchange (El Ranchito Plumbing, Space Coast Cooling, LeadStone) are kept but flagged in notes.

Many entries still rest on a single Cylex listing. Cylex now returns HTTP 403 to direct fetching, so those entries could not be re-opened or matched to a second source; they are marked 'unverified: one aggregated directory listing (Cylex) only' in active_evidence and should be treated as existence-unconfirmed, not merely activity-unconfirmed.

Bulk-directory entries (CityVero aggregated listings: C-Fanelli Landscape Supply and Nursery, Collins Landcare, Monroe Grounds Management, and the 124 Pergola Ave address for Supreme Outdoor Maintenance) are marked as such and need independent confirmation.
Several Monroe contractors are home-based; the addresses shown are the ones the businesses or directories publish, not home addresses gathered from any personal source.

Zone interpretation: only businesses with a Monroe Township, NJ address were counted. Jamesburg, Helmetta, Englishtown, Spotswood, Cranbury, East Brunswick and Manalapan businesses that appeared in Monroe searches were excluded even when within 10 miles of Milltown.

Most entries have no website recorded because no website was seen linked from a listing that could be opened; the triage team should look those up. The Biondo website field was deliberately cleared because the previously recorded domain no longer serves that business.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap Overpass API was unreachable (query timed out), so no OSM cross-check of trade businesses was possible; the Nominatim geocoder was used only for distance checks.

Yellow Pages, BBB category pages, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BuildZoom, Superpages, Manta, Find-open, eHardhat, unilocal and Cylex all returned 403/Cloudflare blocks to direct fetching; Yellow Pages and BBB data here came from search-result snippets and two BBB profile pages.

Google Maps still returns a sign-in-limited five-result list view, so each Maps category query surfaced only the top five businesses (plus five from Bing Maps); map coverage is therefore top-of-category, not exhaustive.
No Monroe Township chamber of commerce or township-issued licensed-business roster was found; the township site's phone directory covers municipal departments only.
NJ Division of Consumer Affairs contractor licence lookup was not queried (no browsable town-level list), so licence status is unverified for every entry.

Websites and phone numbers are still missing for a few entries (Air Management HVAC, Next Level Air Duct, Alen Security, C-Fanelli, Collins Landcare, Monroe Grounds Management) because no listing seen published a value.
The distance screen covers only the addresses actually geocoded in this revision; the remaining entries carry the addresses as published without an independently recomputed distance.
